title: Add explicit release channels and digest-preserving promotions
description: Adds configurable SemVer release targets, persistent internal build numbering, automated internal images, and manual beta and release-candidate promotion workflows. Promotions preserve the selected image digest and publish separate channel metadata for application update notifications.
upgrade: The migration does not rename remote branches, change the default branch, publish packages, or move existing tags. Preserve the existing 0.2.0 stable release and legacy image tags; create and protect main and develop from the documented source branches before enabling the new delivery workflows. The initial next release target is explicitly configured as 0.3.0.
limitations: GitHub branch protections, Actions environments and approvals, Actions permissions, and GHCR package access must be configured manually. Update checks are opt-in and only notify; image deployment remains an operator action.
